0022600005.text: Both teams open their 2026-27 seasons when the Golden State Warriors visit the Los Angeles Lakers. The Warriors will be without Jimmy Butler III and Moses Moody, who are both out following knee surgery, and Kristaps Porzingis is day-to-day with an undisclosed reason and is a game-time decision. Golden State lost the 2025-26 season series 1-3, including a 119-103 loss in San Francisco on April 9, and ESPN's matchup predictor gives the Warriors a 35% chance to win.
